PIB: lifts, escalators and FOBs at Western Railway stations

method_note: Western Railway has not published a station-wise accessibility list for this division. These details are pieced together from the sources below, some several years old; they may have changed and don't say whether lifts are working. Anything else shows as "No data yet".

Ahmedabad.note: 7 lifts (Lok Sabha answer, as on 31 Jul 2023)

Gandhidham.note: 2 lifts (Lok Sabha answer, as on 31 Jul 2023)

Mahesana.note: 4 lifts (division presentation, about 2020–21; may be out of date)

Bhuj.note: 2 lifts (division presentation, about 2020–21; more lifts are part of the new Bhuj station works (PIB))

Ahmedabad.note: 14 escalators (Lok Sabha answer, as on 31 Jul 2023)

Gandhidham.note: 4 escalators (Lok Sabha answer, as on 31 Jul 2023)

Bhuj.note: Escalators are part of the new Bhuj station works (PIB)

Ahmedabad.note: IRCTC e-wheelchair: call 8287931890, collect at the concourse, book at least 6 hours ahead (IRCTC listing, undated)
